methods.name: semi-supervised generated countermeasure network (SSGAN)
methods.summary: A semi-supervised generative adversarial network (SSGAN) that extends the traditional GAN framework by expanding the discriminator to perform N+1 class classification (N landslide categories plus one for generated pseudo-images). It uses both labeled and unlabeled samples to improve classification accuracy with limited labeled data.
methods.verbatim: this paper proposes to construct a semi-supervised generated countermeasure network (SSGAN) model... The experiments were conducted in Python using the TensorFlow framework

availability.author_statement: The data presented in this study are available on request from the corresponding author. The data are not publicly available due to privacy.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or provided, and the custom SSGAN code is not available via a repository or persistent link.
